_note: Discover Taif guide — 17 places imported 9 Oct 2026 from the legacy discovertaif.armadaresidence.com export (legacy-sites/discover-taif.zip → build.py data). Names, copy, alt texts and Google Maps links are verbatim; photos are the legacy Armada-owned set re-encoded to WebP in content/images/taif/ (800 + 1400 widths). nearest_branch assigned by geography (see nearest_reason); no distances or drive times are stated. Addas Mosque is intentionally absent. Collections, search keywords and hero come from the legacy guide too (design kept as-is per decision 9 Oct 2026).
